desc:
🕺 DISCO UPDATE! Disco Night weather, the new GOLD DISCO mutation (x10) and a giant dancing admin abuse!

Grow fruit, cook Thai street food and run the busiest stall in the market! 🥗
🌱 Plant papaya, chilies, mango, dragon fruit, durian and more
🥢 Pound som tam, cook larb & nam tok, grill moo ping with sticky rice
🧑‍🍳 Serve customers, earn tips and level up your stall
🧺 Hire a helper to farm and cook for you

🌧️ WEATHER & MUTATIONS
Rain, heatwave, wind, full moon, thunderstorms and Disco Night mutate your fruit: Wet, Moonlit, Shocked, Disco, Golden, Rainbow... Mutated fruit sells for way more!

🥷 STEAL TIME: when night falls, grab a basket and steal ripe fruit from other gardens!

🎉 ADMIN ABUSE: every server parties at once with x2 luck, a free seed restock and lasers that turn fruit GOLD DISCO!

📖 Fruit book · 📅 Daily quests · 🎟️ Codes
👍 Like the game for a free Golden Tomato seed
👥 Join Baby Birds Games for a free Golden Papaya seed
